children.text: Sales reps need a sharper contractor target list
The app converts public contractor listings and web research into a shared, ranked view of who to sell to first.
GAF contractor results are useful, but they are not sales-ready: reps still need company size, contact paths, buying signals, and a concise reason to prioritize one account over another.
Goal: prioritize most likely to buy, then largest company.
Primary users who need a fast way to decide which contractors to contact first, what to say, and why each company deserves priority.
